Usko Paana Hai To Poora Pagal Ban | Varun Anand Ki Shayari | Jashn-e-Rekhta
In this Jashn-e-Rekhta moment, Varun Anand delivers “Usko Paana Hai To Poora Pagal Ban” with the kind of directness that makes the room lean in. The piece plays on that familiar tension between pride and vulnerability, where love stops being a polite emotion and turns into something unapologetically consuming. With a crisp performance and clean timing, Varun keeps it sharp, relatable, and honest, letting the punch of each line land without dressing it up.
